Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

think — to have an opinion in your mind. Example: I think cities will be bigger.
believe — to think something is true. Example: I believe schools need more music.
opinion — what you think about something. Example: In my opinion the village is better.
good — of high quality. Example: Sport is good for children.
bad — of low quality. Example: The traffic is bad.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I think ...
• I believe ...
• In my opinion ...
• What do you think?
• It is a good idea.
